apiMessages.content: Plan my training between now and the trip. Schedule the sessions.

content.text:
Two weeks out. Goal now: peak this week, taper next week, arrive fresh Aug 17. No new fitness to build — sharpen and back off.

**Week 1 (peak) — keep your existing two, add one:**
- Tue Aug 4 — Limit Bouldering ✓ (power)
- Thu Aug 6 — Hangboard + Core ✓ (strength maintenance)
- Sat Aug 8 — Power Endurance (4x4s) — RRG is pumpy; this is the specific engine

**Week 2 (taper) — cut volume, keep intensity crisp:**
- Tue Aug 11 — Route mileage + technique (submax, feel good)
- Thu Aug 13 — Short primer (light hangs + a few boulders, leave fresh)
- Fri–Sun Aug 14–16 — rest / travel. No climbing.

Scheduling the three new sessions:

input.title: Pre-Trip Primer
input.description: Last session before trip. Prime the system, don't tax it. A few light hangs, a handful of moderate boulders. Stop while fresh.

exercises.name: Project / Push
exercises.notes: 4 moderate boulders, well under limit. Quality over quantity. Done when they feel easy.

input.title: Route Mileage + Technique
input.description: Taper week. Submax volume on routes. Focus on smooth movement, footwork, and clipping/resting positions. Nothing to failure.

exercises.name: Technique Practice (fresh)
exercises.notes: 5 moderate routes. Perfect feet, quiet movement, find rests. Stop with gas in the tank.

input.title: Power Endurance — 4x4s
input.description: Peak-week pump training. RRG routes are long and continuous — build the engine now. 4 boulder problems, 4 rounds, minimal rest within a round.

exercises.name: Project / Push
exercises.rest_period: rest = climb time, then repeat. 4 rounds total.
exercises.notes: Pick 4 sub-limit problems. Climb all 4 with no rest between, rest equal to climb time, repeat 4x. Target a deep pump, not failure.
